headline: Chilean Prosecutors to Question Former Codelco Chair Over Copper Overcount
summary: Chilean prosecutors will summon former Codelco chairman Máximo Pacheco regarding a 27,000-tonne copper inventory overcount identified at the state mining company.
why: Codelco is the world's largest copper mining company; corporate governance and inventory reporting accuracy directly impact global metal supply confidence.

impacts.name: Codelco
impacts.why: Prosecutorial inquiries into executive oversight and copper inventory accounting create operational and legal scrutiny.
